name: Gemma 4 31B

release_date.note: Raschka gallery date; the report followed on arXiv 2026-07-02

params.note: Hub safetensors count incl. towers; text_only derived from config. Card: 30.7B; report Table 1: vision 550M, embedder 1,410M, einsums 29,290M

tokenizer.note: report: Gemini tokenizer, split digits, byte-level encodings

stack.note: global at 0-based layers 5, 11, ... 59; the last layer is global. Global layers: head 512, 4 KV heads

steps.label: local: window 1024, head 256, theta 10k / global: full, head 512, p-RoPE 0.25, theta 1M, values = keys
RMSNorm on q and k per head (v gets a scale-free RMSNorm); scores not divided by sqrt(head_dim)
layer output times a stored scalar

specials.name: partial_rope
specials.what: p-RoPE: only 25% of each global head's dims rotate (theta 1M); local layers use full RoPE (theta 10k)

specials.name: tied_embeddings
specials.what: output head reuses the embedding table

specials.name: layer_scalar
specials.what: each layer's output is multiplied by a stored scalar

specials.name: mtp
specials.what: a separate autoregressive drafter head for speculative decoding, fed the main model's activations and KV cache
specials.where: released beside the model; not in this repo

specials.name: k_eq_v
specials.what: global layers have no value projection: values = keys (attention_k_eq_v)

omitted_towers.what: ViT, patch 16, axial 2D RoPE plus 2D absolute positions, variable aspect ratio

paper.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
paper.note: section 2, Table 1 (parameter counts), section 2.1-2.2 (encoders), Figure 1 (MTP drafter)

readme.note: property table: parameters, layers, sliding window, context, encoder sizes; hybrid attention, last layer global

code.note: Gemma4TextDecoderLayer: input norm, attn, post-attn norm, add, pre-ffw norm, MLP, post-ffw norm, add, [per-layer input gate, GELU, x PLE, projection, norm, add], x layer_scalar; attention scaling 1.0 with q/k RMSNorm and scale-free v norm

cfgcode.note: configuration_gemma4.py: per_layer_config sets global head_dim 512 and global KV heads when attention_k_eq_v; kv_sharing_modes

hfapi.note: license apache-2.0, license_link gemma_4_license, safetensors total 31,273,088,876

count.note: Vd (tied) + per layer q/o d*H*hd, k (and v unless k_eq_v) d*KV*hd on non-shared layers, q/k norms, GeGLU 3*d*f, 4 norms, scalar + final norm
